question: Mahashay Dharampal Gulati, who passed away in December 2020, was the owner of iconic spice brand _______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**MDH**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mahashay Dharampal Gulati** was the founder of MDH.
 
• **MDH** is an **Indian spice company**.
 
• He** **was awarded **Padma Bhushan, in 2019**.
 
• **He is also called Spice King**
 
• **MDH was opened in 1919 in Sialkot (now in Pakistan).**
